description: Render a .blend file, or a Python script that builds a scene with bpy, to an MP4 using the Blender installed on this machine. quality draft is small (360p), low-sample and may skip frames so you can check the scene in seconds; look at it, then render final at the scene's own size and samples. Returns the MP4 path, duration, size, renderer and frame count. Needs Blender; status says if it is installed.

allowScripts.description: Let Python stored inside the .blend run. Off by default.

audio.description: Soundtrack file to lay under the film.

file.description: A .blend file or a .py scene script.

out.description: Output .mp4 path. Default: renders/<name>-<quality>.mp4 next to the scene.

quality.description: draft = fast and small, to check your work; final = full quality.

range.description: Frames to render, e.g. "1-48" or "12". Default: the scene's range.

step.description: Render every Nth frame; the film keeps its length.

name: render_blender
title: Render a Blender scene to MP4
